name: Split screen
oneliner: You on top, the footage on the bottom, at the same time.
description: Show the work while you explain it: the dish being plated, the room being shown, the cut happening.
prompt: For segments where the speaker walks through a process and matching b-roll exists, switch to a vertical split. Top half (1080x960): the speaker, reframed so the eyes sit at y=380. Bottom half (1080x960): the b-roll, cropped to fill. Divider: a 6px {{brand.accent}} line at y=960. Captions move onto the divider (centered on y=960 inside a dark pill) so they stay out of the bottom 320px. Enter with the bottom panel sliding up from below, ease-out 300ms; exit over 200ms. Hold each split 3-8s. Do NOT letterbox, do NOT shrink the speaker so far the eyes are hard to see, and keep the speaker's audio throughout.
